comment: Every source asset the demo library derives from: pinned URL, sha256, byte size, kind (poster, backdrop, still, headshot or media: what the file IS, which decides the roles it may fill), pixel width and height, licence, author and attribution. A headshot also records `tags`, the Commons file page's tags at pinning time. tools/demo_library.py fetches them into ~/.cache/plxnative-demo and refuses a file whose hash or size differs.
